track_triangulate — DRIVE balltrack op

• 数据种类:table × any × any → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.track_triangulate(tracks, poses, Ks, n_frames: 'int') -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import balltrack; balltrack.track_triangulate(tracks, poses, Ks, n_frames: 'int') -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("track_triangulate"))

用法

对各相机的轨迹(ball_track 的返回值)做三角测量，得到 3-D 轨迹：{"frame", "p" (N, 3), "reproj_rms" (N,)}(仅限在 2 个以上视角中可见的帧)。
